violations.reason: The saved trajectory declared the request impossible and transferred the user, although the canonical policy and public update tool permit a cabin-only change from unflown Basic to Economy, an Economy-state date change, and cabin restoration. The user had authorized compliant intermediate changes and the Phase 15F native validation established the path. This is the same unnecessary-transfer pattern the unchanged Judge correctly identified in travel_request_023_03.
